notes.title: New Demo patch is live - The final trap is now a lot more fair!
notes.notes:
During our extensive playtesting with new players we found that most of them hit the same wall in gameplay so we adjusted the main issue and made the trap more fair. Other than that we used the opportunity to fix some more things in the demo:

Visual:
1. There is a leaf particle that shows when you take damage
2. Leaves now glow when regaining health

Balancing:
1. The last trap now has a slower delay time
2. The last turret has more wind up before shooting to give players the opportunity to dodge
3. Reduced the amount of spikes at the beginning of the game (it was kind of too much considering the players are still adjusting to the movement)

Share more feedback with us to help us polish up the demo!

Thank you to all the players who helped us locate these issues.

notes.title: The Demo for Copperfields is live!
notes.notes:
During the last week, we finished creating the final build for the Demo. Implementing sound effects, music, UI, and adapting the tutorials for all controllers. Now we are so happy to officially share it with all our expecting players! 

The game is inspired by Rain World and Inside so expect puzzles, strange ecosystems, and a lot of fun! We presented the game as best as possible in the new Gameplay Trailer: [previewyoutube=za_rP04mlxQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We polished everything, playtested with lots of players, and are very proud of the game and can’t wait to hear your thoughts about the gameplay! Feel free to join our Discord group to become part of the community and to get updates faster than ever. Every link is inside the Demo so hop on and enjoy!

notes.title: New Teaser Trailer showcasing our first visual update!
notes.notes:
After much effort to get this update to you as fast as possible, we give you a new teaser showcasing some parts of our post-apocalyptic world!

[previewyoutube=cMV8jC2JByE;full][/previewyoutube]

The new trailer features more background art and atmosphere of the mood that Copperfields brings in this natural dystopia. Showcasing decimated interiors of the mechanical infrastructure that is left behind by the robot civilization and a more in depth view of the overgrown landscape. 

The game is coming along very nicely and we're so happy to share that progress with you. The Demo will be here sooner than you think so stay tuned!

notes.title: Copperfields - Steam Page Announcement Trailer is Live!
notes.notes:
[b]Just launched the Steam Page and a new trailer for Copperfields![/b]

It's our first Indie game project and the theme is a post apocalyptic precision puzzle platformer where you are a plant that takes control of a robot and uses it to search for water! 

The game will evolve tremendously but we hope that you enjoy the first look at our trailer and that you wishlist and support us if you're a fan of the genre and follow our progress!
